aboutText: Diamond Skylights has been Heidelberg Heights' trusted name for over 20 years, specialising in skylights, roof windows, and blinds. We offer a wide range of products designed to enhance comfort and energy efficiency. Our systems are built for reliable performance, making homes brighter and more inviting. Whether for new builds or renovations, we deliver long-term value.
servicesText: At Diamond Skylights, we provide comprehensive skylight solutions including VELUX products, roof windows, and solar tubes. Our certified team handles everything from consultation to installation, ensuring energy efficiency and comfort in your home. We specialise in custom solutions for both new and existing properties.
